_comment: E10.2 complete checkpointed self-output pools and strict paired candidate gate; valid negative results retained; no default change.

jobs.name: e10_self
cmd: set -eu; out="$1"; mkdir -p "$out"; for f in ember.tgz pick.gguf pk.gguf eval100.jsonl pick_pool.jsonl pk_pool.jsonl pick_table.bin pk_table.bin COMMITS self_output_vm.sh INPUT_SHA256SUMS; do cp "/content/chat/upload/$f" "/content/$f"; done; rc=0; bash /content/self_output_vm.sh || rc=$?; cp /content/vm.log "$out/vm.log"; if [ -s /content/out.zip ]; then cp /content/out.zip "$out/out.zip"; fi; if [ -s /content/out/gate_summary.json ]; then cp /content/out/gate_summary.json "$out/gate_summary.json"; fi; exit "$rc"
